item.text: BLOCKER — `DefinitionContext<'src>` still ties temporary mutable borrows to `'src`. In `context_types`, `css`, `references`, `active`, `counters`, and `builder` are all `&'src mut ...`. That prevents the context’s mutable borrows from being independent of the source lifetime, despite the corrected `DefinitionPlan<'src>` and plan signatures. Give `DefinitionContext` a separate context-borrow lifetime, e.g. `DefinitionContext<'src, 'ctx>` with source/token/CSS data parameterized by `'src` and mutable references by `'ctx`, then update both plan signatures. The trait method’s explicit lifetime remains object safe; the plan’s ownership semantics need not change.
